              type: string
              example: 'FY26'
              readOnly: true

              type: string

              readOnly: true
            timezone:

              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicateOf:
              title: Possible duplicate of

              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            deleted:
              title: Deleted
              description: Whether this owner has been soft-deleted. A newly created owner is false; DELETE /api/owners/{id} marks it true while retaining the record, and deleted owners are ignored by the create endpoint's duplicate/identity checks.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            contactPreference:
              title: Contact preference
              description: The owner's preferred contact channel, 'EMAIL' when an email is present, otherwise 'PHONE'.

          title: Address

          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255

        addressLine1:
          title: Address line 1

          type: string
          maxLength: 255

              type: string
              example: 'A1B2C3D4E5F6'
              readOnly: true

              title: Identity key

              example: '+61412345678||A1B2C3D4E5F6'
              readOnly: true

Starts at 0, plus 2 when an email is present, plus 1 when namesakeCount is 0, plus 2 for a household of 3 or more members, plus 3 for a tenure of one or more elapsed fiscal years (each starting 1 July) between the registrationDate and today.
              type: integer

              minimum: 0

              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:

              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 4

            locality:
